marketing.chooseTitle: Why choose KeduckAI for AI content creation and publishing
marketing.choosePoint1Desc: Xiaohongshu is generated with image-text content logic, while WeChat, Toutiao, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN follow their own content scenarios instead of simple one-draft reuse.
marketing.choosePoint2Desc: Chat publishing, manual publishing, and scheduled publishing fit trends, polished drafts, and recurring columns, helping teams move faster after content is generated.
marketing.testimonialsSubtitle: Feedback from content operators, brand teams, and creators
marketing.testimonial1Quote: We used to spend the most time finding topics and revising drafts. Now we use topic inspiration first, then generate Xiaohongshu posts and multi-platform articles much faster.
marketing.testimonial2Quote: What we value most is execution. Once the scheduled plan is set, the system can generate and publish content on time, so weekly columns need much less monitoring.
marketing.testimonial3Quote: The visual matching workflow is a pleasant surprise. AI generation, web search, and media library sources reduce the time we spend finding and selecting images.
marketing.guidePageLead: Start from topic inspiration or enter a one-sentence topic directly. KeduckAI helps you create Xiaohongshu posts, multi-platform articles, smart visuals, editing confirmation, and publishing tracking.
marketing.guideStep1Desc:
Open the topic inspiration page and browse recommended trending topics, content directions, or creative angles. You can select a topic to start creating, or adjust it based on your industry, product, or account positioning.

If you already have a clear topic direction, you can skip this step and go straight to content generation.
marketing.guideStep2Desc:
Choose the content type based on your publishing needs, such as Xiaohongshu image-text post, Zhihu article, WeChat Official Account article, Toutiao article, Baijiahao article, or CSDN technical article.

For seeding, store visits, and product promotion, choose Xiaohongshu image-text posts. For viewpoints, knowledge sharing, news tracking, Baidu content ecosystem exposure, or technical tutorials, choose the matching platform content type.
marketing.guideStep3Title: Enter a topic or use topic inspiration
marketing.guideStep3Desc:
You can enter a one-sentence topic directly, or choose a direction from topic inspiration to generate content.

For example: how to choose skincare for sensitive skin in spring, how beginners can start self-media, a Python crawler beginner tutorial, or promotional copy for a new coffee shop product.
marketing.guideStep4Desc:
After clicking generate, the tool creates content for the selected platform and can match visuals based on the topic.

Xiaohongshu posts usually include title, body copy, tags, and image copy. Zhihu, WeChat Official Account, Toutiao, Baijiahao, and CSDN content usually includes title, article structure, body sections, visuals, and publishing copy.
marketing.guideStep5Desc: After generation, you can optimize the title, adjust the tone, add product information, replace examples, or remove unnecessary sections in the editor. Before publishing, check key information such as price, timing, data, product claims, brand names, image copyright, and visual relevance.
marketing.guideStep6Desc:
KeduckAI supports three publishing methods:

Chat publishing: after content generation, tell AI which platform or account to publish to. Suitable for temporary trends and fast publishing.
Manual publishing: edit and confirm in the document, then manually choose the platform and account. Suitable for polished content that needs human confirmation.
Auto-publishing: create a scheduled plan with task name, prompt, publishing account, and timing rules. The system generates and publishes content on schedule, suitable for daily updates, weekly updates, fixed columns, and ongoing operations.
marketing.guideStep7Desc: After publishing, view publishing records and track success, failure, or in-progress status by platform.
marketing.pricingPageLead: Credits power chat creation and scheduled-plan automation (including cadence-based generation and publish steps). Final amounts are shown in-app.
marketing.pricingFootnote: Prices and promotions may change; see the in-app purchase dialog for current amounts and invoices.
marketing.faqPageLead: Common questions about target users, credits, data safety, platform support, smart visuals, and auto-publishing.
marketing.faq1Q: Who is this tool suitable for?
marketing.faq1A: It is suitable for content creators, social media operators, enterprise marketers, brand promoters, knowledge bloggers, technical creators, e-commerce sellers, training organizations, and anyone who needs continuous content output.
marketing.faq2A: Steps such as chat generation, visual generation, tool calls, and scheduled-plan execution consume credits according to rules. Refer to in-app details for specifics.
marketing.faq3A: Please download and access the product through official channels. For sensitive content, follow your organization's compliance requirements and regularly back up important materials and final drafts.
marketing.faq4Q: What publishing methods are available, and how should I choose?
marketing.faq4A:
There are three methods: chat publishing, manual publishing, and auto-publishing.

Chat publishing is suitable for temporary trends and fast publishing. Manual publishing is suitable for content that needs editing, polishing, and confirmation before release. Auto-publishing is suitable for daily updates, weekly updates, fixed columns, and ongoing operations. After creating a scheduled plan, the system generates and publishes content on time.
marketing.faq5A:
Auto-publishing runs through scheduled plans. After creating a task, users fill in the task name, prompt, publishing account, visual method, and timing rules, such as “publish once every day at 8 AM.” The system executes content generation at the specified time and publishes to the selected platform account.

Tasks can be enabled, disabled, edited, and run immediately, making it easier to adjust to different operation rhythms.
marketing.faq6A: Topic inspiration works like a self-media topic tool, helping users find content directions and solve the problem of not knowing what to write.
marketing.faq7Q: How are Xiaohongshu posts different from article content?
marketing.faq7A: Xiaohongshu posts focus on note-style copy, seeding, titles, tags, and image copy. WeChat, Toutiao, Zhihu, Baijiahao, and CSDN focus more on article structure, viewpoints, news content, knowledge explanation, or technical tutorials.
marketing.faq8Q: Which content supports smart image matching?
marketing.faq8A: Smart image matching is mainly used for article content such as Zhihu, WeChat Official Account, Toutiao, and CSDN.
marketing.faq9Q: Can I keep editing after content is generated?
marketing.faq9A: Yes. After generation, you can continue editing titles, body copy, and article structure before publishing.
marketing.faq10Q: Can generated content be published directly?
marketing.faq10A: Yes, but we recommend reviewing prices, campaign dates, product claims, data conclusions, and image copyright before publishing.
marketing.faq11A: KeduckAI supports Xiaohongshu posts, Xiaohongshu notes, Xiaohongshu copy, WeChat Official Account articles, Toutiao articles, Zhihu articles, Baijiahao articles, CSDN articles, and more. Exact capabilities depend on the in-app version.
marketing.faq12A: Yes. For technical topics, choose CSDN or related article generation to create tutorials, troubleshooting guides, and experience posts.
